license_required.quote: No mechanical contractor shall engage in any plumbing and piping work or any heating, piping and cooling work, or offer to perform such work, in this state without first obtaining a certificate of registration from the commissioner

required.quote: All applicants for a certificate of registration under this section shall submit satisfactory proof establishing that the applicant: (1) Has fulfilled all of its obligations to the state and is current on all tax payments to the state; and (2) Employs only persons licensed or registered pursuant to chapter 393
